entries.en: Collingwood spilt tea on the tickets just as the taxi arrived.
entries.zh: 出租车刚到，科灵伍德就把茶洒在了票上。

entries.en: Wadsworth replaced the missing button with one from an old coat.
entries.zh: 沃兹沃思用旧外套上的一颗纽扣替换了丢失的那颗。

entries.en: Bowlby mistook the creaking floorboards for someone knocking downstairs.
entries.zh: 鲍尔比把地板的吱嘎声误当成了楼下有人敲击的声音。

entries.en: Barham turned the chair around so that the torn upholstery faced the wall.
entries.zh: 巴勒姆把椅子转了过去，让包面破损的一侧朝着墙。

entries.en: The microbiologist compared two photographs of Shigella before writing her report.
entries.zh: 那位微生物学家在写报告前比较了两张志贺氏菌属细菌的照片。

entries.en: Snow hid the narrow path through the Carpathian forest.
entries.zh: 雪遮住了穿过喀尔巴阡山脉森林的那条狭窄小路。

entries.en: A Thomist in the seminar challenged my reading of the passage.
entries.zh: 研讨会上的一位托马斯主义者质疑了我对那段文字的解读。

entries.meaningZh: 伦弗鲁郡〔苏格兰原郡名〕
entries.en: Her old diary describes a wet autumn spent in Renfrewshire.
entries.zh: 她的旧日记描写了在伦弗鲁郡度过的一个多雨的秋天。

entries.en: Persil found a silver earring caught in the lining of the bag.
entries.zh: 珀西尔在包的衬里发现了一只挂在那里的银耳环。

entries.en: The lecturer enlarged the photograph of the Saturnian rings for the back row.
entries.zh: 讲师放大了土星环的照片，好让后排的人看清。

entries.en: Bollinger had brought the cake but forgotten the candles.
entries.zh: 博林杰带来了蛋糕，却忘了带蜡烛。

entries.en: Carlile refused to take the last chair while anyone else was standing.
entries.zh: 只要还有别人站着，卡莱尔就不肯坐最后那把椅子。

entries.en: Laszlo rescued the sketchbook before the puddle reached its pages.
entries.zh: 水洼里的水还没浸到纸页，拉斯洛就救起了那本素描簿。

entries.en: Adolfo tucked the loose shoelace inside his shoe until he could stop.
entries.zh: 阿道夫暂时把松开的鞋带塞在鞋里，等有机会停下来。

entries.en: Leverhulme opened the picnic basket to find that the jar had leaked.
entries.zh: 利弗休姆打开野餐篮，发现罐子里的东西漏了出来。

entries.en: Wilks pushed the wardrobe aside and uncovered a patch of faded wallpaper.
entries.zh: 威尔克斯把衣柜推到一边，露出了一块褪色的墙纸。

entries.en: A Masham squeezed through the open gate before the farmer could reach it.
entries.zh: 农夫还没来得及赶过去，一只马沙姆杂交羊就从敞开的门挤了出去。

entries.en: Cunliffe could hear the dripping tap even through the closed door.
entries.zh: 即使隔着关上的门，坎利夫也能听见水龙头滴水的声音。

entries.en: The seminar ended with a lively disagreement about Bolivarian ideals.
entries.zh: 研讨会最后围绕玻利瓦尔的理想展开了一场热烈的争论。

entries.en: Boden drew a curtain across the alcove to hide the stacked boxes.
entries.zh: 博登拉上凹室前的帘子，挡住了堆在里面的箱子。

entries.en: Blackadder brought a ladder that was too short to reach the gutter.
entries.zh: 布拉凯德带来的梯子太短，够不到檐沟。

entries.en: Robey carried the dripping umbrella straight through the freshly cleaned kitchen.
entries.zh: 罗比拿着滴水的伞，径直穿过了刚打扫干净的厨房。

entries.en: Luka found that the handwritten instructions made more sense upside down.
entries.zh: 卢卡发现，把那份手写说明倒过来看反而更容易看懂。

entries.en: Edvard left a gap between the chairs for the sleeping dog.
entries.zh: 爱德华在椅子之间留了个空当，给那只睡着的狗腾地方。

entries.en: Deutscher held the broken handle in place while I fetched the glue.
entries.zh: 我去拿胶水时，多伊彻扶住了断掉的把手。

entries.en: The bottle of Cointreau rolled towards the edge when the tray tilted.
entries.zh: 托盘一歪，那瓶Cointreau橘味白酒就朝边缘滚了过去。

entries.en: Bushell could not remember which pocket held the cloakroom ticket.
entries.zh: 布谢尔记不起衣帽间的取物牌放在哪个口袋里了。

entries.en: The rosser stopped and pulled a splinter from his glove.
entries.zh: 那个剥树皮的伐木工人停下来，拔掉了手套上的一根木刺。

entries.en: Monkhouse blamed the uneven table for the coffee on his trousers.
entries.zh: 蒙克豪斯把洒在裤子上的咖啡归咎于那张不平的桌子。

entries.en: Metcalf lowered the radio so that we could hear the announcement.
entries.zh: 梅特卡夫把收音机的音量调低，好让我们听清广播通知。

entries.en: Merle felt something moving inside the shoe he was about to put on.
entries.zh: 默尔正要穿鞋，却感觉到鞋里有什么东西在动。

entries.en: McLellan folded the map along its old creases and handed it back.
entries.zh: 麦克莱伦沿着旧折痕叠好地图，把它还了回去。

entries.en: Someone had left a shopping trolley behind the parked Benz.
entries.zh: 有人把一辆购物推车留在了那辆停着的奔驰车后面。

entries.en: The new owner Europeanized the dining room but left the kitchen unchanged.
entries.zh: 新主人把餐厅改成了欧洲风格，却保留了厨房的原样。

entries.en: Wimborne found a teaspoon wedged beneath the cushion of the armchair.
entries.zh: 温伯恩发现扶手椅的坐垫下面卡着一把茶匙。

entries.en: Roxanne tied a ribbon around the box to keep its lid shut.
entries.zh: 洛葛仙妮在盒子上系了一条丝带，免得盒盖打开。

entries.en: Nugent returned with the milk just as the kettle began to whistle.
entries.zh: 纽金特拿着牛奶回来时，水壶正好开始鸣叫。

entries.en: Lazard crouched beneath the table to retrieve the scattered chess pieces.
entries.zh: 拉扎德蹲到桌子下面，去捡散落的棋子。

entries.en: We reached Didsbury with rainwater dripping from the ends of our sleeves.
entries.zh: 我们到迪兹伯里时，雨水正从袖口往下滴。

entries.en: Darley had mistaken the parcel for a cushion and sat on it.
entries.zh: 达利把那个包裹当成了坐垫，坐了上去。

entries.en: Dalston returned the borrowed saucepan with a handwritten apology inside.
entries.zh: 达尔斯顿归还了借来的煮锅，里面放着一张手写的道歉便条。

entries.en: Cesare ran a finger along the shelf and looked at the dust.
entries.zh: 切萨雷用一根手指抹过架子，看了看沾上的灰尘。

entries.en: Belgrano tried the window before realising that it had been painted shut.
entries.zh: 贝尔格拉诺试着开窗，才意识到窗子已经被油漆粘住了。

entries.en: Almeida recognised the tune but could not remember where she had heard it.
entries.zh: 阿尔梅达认出了那段旋律，却想不起曾在哪里听过。

entries.en: Whitty stopped the swinging door with his foot to protect the vase.
entries.zh: 惠蒂用脚挡住来回摆动的门，免得花瓶受损。

entries.en: We found a packet of crushed Weetabix at the bottom of the shopping bag.
entries.zh: 我们在购物袋底发现了一包被压碎的维他麦。

entries.en: My suitcase reached Trowbridge a day before I did.
entries.zh: 我的行李箱比我早一天到了特罗布里奇。

entries.en: Spink spotted the torn sleeve only after the photographs had been taken.
entries.zh: 照片拍完以后，斯平克才发现袖子破了。

entries.meaningZh: 出身低微的〔苏格兰用语〕
entries.en: She was semple, but the laird valued her judgement above that of his wealthy neighbours.
entries.zh: 她虽然出身低微，地主却认为她的判断比那些富裕邻居的更有价值。

entries.en: Renshaw shook the rug outside and covered his own shoes in dust.
entries.zh: 伦肖在外面抖地毯，结果把自己的鞋子弄得满是灰尘。

entries.en: Pattison left the chessboard undisturbed so that we could finish tomorrow.
entries.zh: 帕蒂森没有动棋盘，好让我们明天接着下完。

entries.en: Maida caught the falling bowl between her knees without breaking it.
entries.zh: 梅达用双膝夹住了掉下来的碗，没有把碗打碎。

entries.en: The photograph taken in Lossiemouth was blurred by a raindrop on the lens.
entries.zh: 那张在洛西茅斯拍的照片被镜头上的一滴雨水弄模糊了。

entries.en: Hinde fitted the broken pieces together and found that one corner was missing.
entries.zh: 欣德把那些碎片拼起来，发现缺了一个角。

entries.en: Hinchcliffe left the wet paintbrush balanced across an empty jam jar.
entries.zh: 欣奇克利夫把那把湿画笔横放在一个空果酱罐上。

entries.en: We arrived in Goole carrying more luggage than we could comfortably manage.
entries.zh: 我们到古耳时，带的行李多得有些拿不过来。

entries.en: Gabriela spread the damp photographs across the kitchen table to dry.
entries.zh: 加布里埃拉把潮湿的照片摊在厨房桌上晾干。

entries.en: Dearden apologised for the cold room and brought another blanket.
entries.zh: 迪尔登为房间太冷而道歉，又拿来了一条毯子。

entries.en: Rooke held his breath as the ball rolled towards the open drain.
entries.zh: 球朝敞开的排水口滚去时，鲁克屏住了呼吸。

entries.en: In the mystery, a Pinkerton follows the missing clerk's trail to an empty warehouse.
entries.zh: 那篇推理故事里，一名私人侦探循着失踪职员的踪迹来到了一座空仓库。

entries.en: Kershaw tried to flatten the curled photograph beneath a heavy book.
entries.zh: 克肖试着把卷曲的照片压在一本厚书下面压平。

entries.en: The anthology pairs Hibernian ballads with short accounts of the singers' lives.
entries.zh: 那本选集把爱尔兰民谣与歌者的简短生平介绍编排在一起。

entries.en: During rehearsals, the actor playing Gunnar lost his cloak under the wooden bridge.
entries.zh: 排练时，饰演贡纳的演员把斗篷遗落在了木桥下面。

entries.en: Foulke began to laugh when the supposedly empty suitcase barked.
entries.zh: 那个据说空着的行李箱里传出狗叫声，福克笑了起来。

entries.en: Conlon walked past the house twice before recognising the newly painted door.
entries.zh: 康伦两次走过那所房子后，才认出了重新刷过漆的门。

entries.en: Our parcel from Avonmouth arrived wrapped in three layers of brown paper.
entries.zh: 我们从埃文茅斯寄来的包裹到了，外面裹着三层牛皮纸。

entries.en: Walcott had to unpack the whole bag to find the bottle opener.
entries.zh: 沃尔科特不得不把包里的东西全拿出来，才找到开瓶器。

entries.en: I left my favourite sandals in Mallorca and brought home two unmatched socks.
entries.zh: 我把最喜欢的凉鞋忘在了马略卡岛，却带回了两只不成对的袜子。

entries.en: Michaela dropped a stitch while listening to the argument in the next room.
entries.zh: 米凯拉听隔壁房间的人争吵时，织漏了一针。

entries.en: Hartmann rested the cello against the wall and went to answer the door.
entries.zh: 哈特曼把大提琴靠在墙上，去开门了。

entries.en: Hallett peeled the price sticker off the frame before wrapping the picture.
entries.zh: 哈利特先撕掉画框上的价格标签，才把画包起来。

entries.en: Giacomo returned from the shop with everything except the bread we needed.
entries.zh: 贾科莫从商店回来，什么都买了，偏偏没买我们需要的面包。

entries.en: Dench could see her reflection in the spoon but not in the cloudy mirror.
entries.zh: 登奇能在勺子上看到自己的倒影，却在那面模糊的镜子里看不到。

entries.en: Woodley tightened the loose wheel before loading the trolley with books.
entries.zh: 伍德利先把松动的轮子拧紧，才往推车上装书。

entries.en: Nicoll listened at the door and heard only the washing machine.
entries.zh: 尼科尔在门边听了听，只听到洗衣机的声音。

entries.en: Colling hid the birthday present behind a stack of old newspapers.
entries.zh: 科林把生日礼物藏在了一摞旧报纸后面。

entries.en: Bartley watched a moth circle the lamp until the room fell dark.
entries.zh: 巴特利看着一只飞蛾绕着灯打转，直到房间暗了下来。

entries.en: Arturo lent me a jacket with a train ticket still in its pocket.
entries.zh: 阿图罗借给我一件夹克，口袋里还放着一张火车票。

entries.en: Yitzhak noticed that the second drawer was shallower than the first.
entries.zh: 伊扎克注意到第二个抽屉比第一个浅。

entries.en: Weatherall left the broken clock on the mantelpiece because she liked its face.
entries.zh: 韦瑟罗尔喜欢那只坏钟的表盘，便把它留在了壁炉台上。

entries.en: The spiers waited in the orchard until the guards had passed.
entries.zh: 密探们在果园里等着，直到卫兵们走了过去。

entries.en: Rothesay turned the photograph over and found an address written on its back in pencil.
entries.zh: 罗思赛把照片翻过来，发现背面用铅笔写着一个地址。

entries.en: Phillipson moved the lamp closer to examine the tear in the map.
entries.zh: 菲利普森把灯移近，查看地图上撕裂的地方。

entries.en: Patti tipped the last few biscuits onto a plate and hid the empty tin.
entries.zh: 帕蒂把剩下的几块饼干倒在盘子里，藏起了空罐子。

entries.en: Kellett sat on the repaired chair before letting anyone else sit on it.
entries.zh: 凯利特先试坐了修好的椅子，才让其他人坐。

entries.en: Gooding had washed the shirt without noticing the pen in its pocket.
entries.zh: 古丁洗衬衫时，没有注意到口袋里的笔。

entries.en: Clouds hid the Eiger before we could finish our picnic.
entries.zh: 我们还没吃完野餐，云就遮住了艾格尔峰。

entries.en: Burridge rescued the letter from the bin and carefully smoothed it out.
entries.zh: 伯里奇从垃圾桶里捡回了那封信，小心地把它展平。

entries.en: Sheehan cut the ribbon too short and had to start again.
entries.zh: 希恩把丝带剪得太短了，只好重新来过。

entries.en: Riccardo listened to the empty shell, then handed it to the youngest child.
entries.zh: 里卡尔多听了听空贝壳里的声音，然后把它递给了年纪最小的孩子。

entries.en: McCracken noticed the smell of burnt toast before anyone saw the smoke.
entries.zh: 还没等有人看见烟，麦克拉肯就闻到了烤焦面包的气味。

entries.en: Indira sorted the buttons by colour before looking for a matching pair.
entries.zh: 英迪拉先按颜色把纽扣分好，再找一对相配的。

entries.en: Hayter knocked the empty flowerpot over while reaching for his hat.
entries.zh: 海特伸手拿帽子时，碰倒了那个空花盆。

entries.en: Filippo watched the paper boat disappear beneath the little bridge.
entries.zh: 菲利波看着纸船消失在那座小桥下面。

entries.en: Faso loosened his tie and sat down on the lowest step.
entries.zh: 法索松开领带，坐在了最下面一级台阶上。

entries.en: Attwood carried the stool outside to reach the highest apples.
entries.zh: 阿特伍德把凳子搬到外面，好够到最高处的苹果。

entries.en: Maslow put the wet socks on the radiator and forgot about them.
entries.zh: 马斯洛把湿袜子放在暖气片上，后来就忘了这回事。

entries.en: Howlett held the lid down while I tied string around the box.
entries.zh: 我往盒子上捆绳子时，豪利特按住了盒盖。

entries.en: We had already left Alloa when we noticed that the fuel gauge read empty.
entries.zh: 我们离开阿洛厄后，才注意到油表已经指向了空的位置。

entries.en: Nevill found a smooth pebble inside the folded beach towel.
entries.zh: 内维尔在折起来的沙滩巾里发现了一颗光滑的卵石。

entries.en: Goodfellow pulled the tablecloth away before the candle wax could reach it.
entries.zh: 蜡烛的蜡油还没滴到桌布上，古德费洛就把桌布移开了。

entries.en: Andres stared at the envelope before recognising his own handwriting.
entries.zh: 安德烈斯盯着信封看了一会儿，才认出那是自己的笔迹。

entries.en: Wyke propped the gate open with a brick while the van reversed.
entries.zh: 货车倒车时，威克用一块砖顶住了门，不让它关上。

entries.en: Howson wanted the window seat until the sun began to shine in his eyes.
entries.zh: 豪森原本想坐靠窗的位子，直到阳光开始照到他的眼睛。

entries.en: Rosslyn wrapped the chipped cup in newspaper instead of throwing it away.
entries.zh: 罗斯林没有扔掉那只有缺口的杯子，而是用报纸把它包了起来。

entries.en: Ricci discovered that the dog had been sleeping on the missing scarf.
entries.zh: 里奇发现，狗一直睡在那条找不到的围巾上。

entries.en: Our first night in Denison was interrupted by a car alarm outside.
entries.zh: 我们在丹尼森度过的第一夜，被外面的汽车警报声打断了。

entries.en: He used to read Ceefax before he had even made his morning tea.
entries.zh: 他以前连早上的那杯茶都还没泡，就先看起Ceefax电视图文信息了。

entries.en: Bramwell tried to open the jam jar with a towel around its lid.
entries.zh: 布拉姆韦尔用毛巾裹住果酱罐的盖子，试着把它拧开。

entries.en: His Latinate vocabulary made the letter sound far more formal than he intended.
entries.zh: 他使用的拉丁语派生词汇，让那封信读起来比他原本想的正式得多。

entries.en: The notebook I brought back from Hebron still has sand between its pages.
entries.zh: 我从希布伦带回来的那本笔记本，书页之间还夹着沙子。

entries.en: Drysdale looked through the wrong end of the binoculars and burst out laughing.
entries.zh: 德赖斯代尔把望远镜拿反了往里看，突然大笑起来。

entries.en: Rackham held the cupboard door steady while I tightened the hinge.
entries.zh: 我拧紧铰链时，拉克姆扶住橱柜门，不让它晃动。

entries.en: Kirkham arrived with a bunch of flowers wrapped in an old map.
entries.zh: 柯卡姆带着一束用旧地图包起来的花来了。

entries.en: Herzog brushed the crumbs from the bench before offering me a seat.
entries.zh: 赫尔佐克先拂掉长凳上的碎屑，才请我坐下。

entries.en: Eamon counted the plates twice because someone had arrived unexpectedly.
entries.zh: 因为有人突然来访，埃蒙把盘子数了两遍。

entries.en: Dmitri laid the damp gloves flat instead of leaving them in a heap.
entries.zh: 德米特里把湿手套平摊开来，没有把它们堆在一起。

entries.en: Birkin bent the wire into a hook to retrieve the fallen key.
entries.zh: 伯金把铁丝弯成钩子，去捞那把掉下去的钥匙。

entries.en: The parcel from Tobruk contained a scarf and a photograph of an unfamiliar dog.
entries.zh: 从托布鲁克寄来的包裹里，装着一条围巾和一只陌生狗的照片。

entries.en: Dimitri pulled the curtains apart and startled the cat on the windowsill.
entries.zh: 迪米特里拉开窗帘，把窗台上的猫吓了一跳。

entries.en: Beazley waited for the footsteps to fade before opening the door.
entries.zh: 比兹利等脚步声渐渐消失后，才打开门。

entries.en: Halliwell put the shopping down to help a child retrieve a ball.
entries.zh: 哈利韦尔放下买来的东西，去帮一个孩子取球。

entries.en: Coburn wrapped the cracked mirror in a blanket before moving it.
entries.zh: 科伯恩先用毯子把裂开的镜子包好，才搬动它。

entries.en: Our old family album contains a photograph taken in Caernarvon on a rainy afternoon.
entries.zh: 我们家的旧相册里，有一张在卡那封一个雨天下午拍的照片。

entries.en: She cut the most Byronic lines from the poem because they overwhelmed its quieter ending.
entries.zh: 她删掉了诗里最具拜伦诗风的几行，因为它们压过了较为平静的结尾。

entries.en: Tupolev picked up the parcel and heard something rattle inside.
entries.zh: 图波列夫拿起包裹，听见里面有什么东西咔嗒作响。

entries.en: Allman tested the water with his elbow before washing the dog.
entries.zh: 奥尔曼给狗洗澡前，先用手肘试了试水温。

entries.en: The Amerasian illustrator drew a portrait of her paternal grandmother for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 那位美亚混血的插画师为展览画了一幅祖母的肖像。

entries.en: The Okinawan potter showed me a bowl that had cracked during firing.
entries.zh: 那位冲绳岛的陶艺家给我看了一只在烧制时裂开的碗。

entries.en: We reached Kirkcudbright with a flat tyre and cold food in the picnic basket.
entries.zh: 我们到柯尔库布里时，轮胎瘪了，野餐篮里的食物也凉了。

entries.en: Benoit pressed a leaf between the pages of the book he was reading.
entries.zh: 伯努瓦把一片叶子夹进了正在读的书里。

entries.en: Skol caught the sliding plate before it knocked over the glass.
entries.zh: 斯科尔接住了滑动的盘子，没让它碰倒玻璃杯。

entries.en: Schroder found the lost receipt stuck to the sole of his shoe.
entries.zh: 施罗德发现，丢失的收据粘在了自己的鞋底上。

entries.en: She put the tin of Ovaltine on a shelf the dog could not reach.
entries.zh: 她把那罐阿华田放在了狗够不到的架子上。

entries.en: I returned from Oundle with a borrowed suitcase and someone else's umbrella.
entries.zh: 我从昂德尔回来时，带着借来的行李箱和别人的伞。

entries.en: Iqbal looked under the bench and found both missing shoes.
entries.zh: 伊克巴尔往长凳下面一看，找到了那两只不见的鞋。

entries.en: Hopwood realised that the squeaking came from his own wet shoes.
entries.zh: 霍普伍德意识到，吱吱声来自他自己湿透的鞋子。

entries.en: Emmett tried to hide the stain by folding the tablecloth differently.
entries.zh: 埃米特试着换一种叠法来遮住桌布上的污渍。

entries.en: Dafydd stopped playing the violin when he noticed that nobody was listening.
entries.zh: 戴维兹发现没有人在听，便停止了小提琴演奏。

entries.en: Cunha held the basket high enough to keep it above the floodwater.
entries.zh: 库尼亚把篮子举得足够高，没让它浸到洪水里。

entries.en: Christiansen offered me the intact cup and kept the chipped one.
entries.zh: 克里斯蒂安森提出把完好的杯子给我，自己留下了有缺口的那个。

entries.en: Castleton taped the loose pages together before the wind could scatter them.
entries.zh: 风还没把散页吹开，卡斯尔顿就用胶带把它们粘在了一起。

entries.en: Boreham balanced the empty tray on his head to make the children laugh.
entries.zh: 博勒姆把空托盘顶在头上，想逗孩子们发笑。

entries.en: Bianchi found the missing dice rattling inside a hollow toy horse.
entries.zh: 比安奇发现，找不到的骰子在一匹空心玩具马里面咯咯响。

entries.en: A Micronesian at the workshop helped me repair the loose clasp.
entries.zh: 工作坊里的一位密克罗尼西亚人帮我修好了松动的搭扣。

entries.en: Tizard had to remove the drawer before he could reach the fallen photograph.
entries.zh: 蒂泽德不得不先取下抽屉，才能够到掉下去的照片。

entries.en: Tierney watched the puddle spread and finally admitted that the bucket was leaking.
entries.zh: 蒂尔尼看着那摊水蔓延开来，终于承认桶漏水了。

entries.en: Tarrant put a folded napkin beneath the wobbling leg of the table.
entries.zh: 塔兰特在桌子那条晃动的腿下面垫了一张折好的餐巾。

entries.en: During rehearsal, the actor playing Oberon caught his cloak on a chair.
entries.zh: 排练时，饰演奥伯龙的演员的斗篷挂在了一把椅子上。

entries.en: Nikolaus cleared a space on the desk for the sleeping kitten.
entries.zh: 尼古劳斯在书桌上清出了一块地方，给那只睡着的小猫。

entries.en: Mumford found the lid at last, but it belonged to a different saucepan.
entries.zh: 芒福德终于找到了锅盖，但那是另一只煮锅的。

entries.en: Mornington drew the curtains against the glare and returned to his crossword.
entries.zh: 莫宁顿拉上窗帘挡住刺眼的光，继续做他的填字游戏。

entries.en: Lupton had packed the mugs carefully but forgotten to empty one of them.
entries.zh: 勒普顿把杯子小心地装好了，却忘了倒空其中一只。

entries.en: The unopened bottle of Lucozade had rolled beneath the car's front passenger seat.
entries.zh: 那瓶没打开的葡萄适滚到了汽车的副驾驶座下面。

entries.en: Inman lifted the doormat and disturbed a cluster of woodlice.
entries.zh: 英曼掀起门垫，惊动了一群潮虫。

entries.en: Hobsbawm made room for the cake by moving the vase to another table.
entries.zh: 霍布斯鲍姆把花瓶移到另一张桌子上，给蛋糕腾出了地方。

entries.en: Goldsworthy caught the scarf before it slipped through the gap in the fence.
entries.zh: 围巾还没滑过栅栏的缝隙，戈兹沃西就抓住了它。

entries.en: Evangelista offered to mend the seam, but I could not find the matching thread.
entries.zh: 埃万杰利斯塔提出帮忙缝好那道缝，可我找不到相配的线。

entries.en: Dario discovered a layer of old letters beneath the torn drawer lining.
entries.zh: 达里奥在破损的抽屉衬纸下面发现了一层旧信。

entries.en: The actress playing Boadicea asked for a lighter shield before the next rehearsal.
entries.zh: 饰演博阿迪西亚的女演员在下一次排练前，要求换一面轻些的盾牌。

entries.en: Seebohm could tell which envelope held the photograph without opening either one.
entries.zh: 西博姆不用拆开那两个信封，就能分辨出照片装在哪一个里面。

entries.en: Platz left the muddy boots outside and stepped into the hall in his socks.
entries.zh: 普拉茨把沾泥的靴子留在外面，穿着袜子走进了门厅。

entries.en: Novak brought a clean towel for the dog but ended up using it himself.
entries.zh: 诺瓦克给狗拿了条干净毛巾，最后却是自己用上了。

entries.en: Laslett tied the branches together so that they would fit through the doorway.
entries.zh: 拉斯利特把树枝捆在一起，好让它们能穿过门口。

entries.en: Kurtz tried the other key and heard the lock turn at last.
entries.zh: 库尔茨试了另一把钥匙，终于听见锁转动的声音。

entries.en: Koenig weighed the parcel on the kitchen scales before wrapping it.
entries.zh: 凯尼格先用厨房秤称了包裹，才把它包起来。

entries.en: Jeannie touched the wall and found that the paint was still tacky.
entries.zh: 珍妮摸了摸墙，发现油漆还发黏。

entries.en: Humphry offered to carry the box without realising how heavy it was.
entries.zh: 汉弗莱还不知道箱子有多重，就主动提出帮忙搬。

entries.en: He left the Givenchy box unopened beside the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 他把没打开的纪梵希盒子留在了衣柜旁。

entries.en: Forfar turned the cushion over to hide the small burn mark.
entries.zh: 福法把坐垫翻过来，想遮住那块小小的烧痕。

entries.en: Ardenne found a broken comb tooth caught in her sleeve.
entries.zh: 阿登发现，一根折断的梳齿挂在了她的袖子上。

entries.en: Wingfield tried to brush the sand off the blanket before folding it.
entries.zh: 温菲尔德叠毯子前，试着把上面的沙子刷掉。

entries.en: Their old Trabant stood in the yard with a folded ladder on its roof.
entries.zh: 他们那辆旧特拉贝特停在院子里，车顶上放着一架折起来的梯子。

entries.en: Rothwell returned the library book with a pressed flower still between its pages.
entries.zh: 罗思韦尔还了图书馆的书，书页之间还夹着一朵压干的花。

entries.en: Riddell put the saucepan on the wrong burner and wondered why it stayed cold.
entries.zh: 里德尔把煮锅放错了炉头，还纳闷锅怎么一直不热。

entries.en: My postcard from Rajasthan arrived after the suitcase I had sent separately.
entries.zh: 我从拉贾斯坦邦寄出的明信片，比另寄的行李箱还晚到。

entries.en: Prout held the flashlight while I searched beneath the bed for the missing ring.
entries.zh: 我在床底下找那枚丢失的戒指时，普劳特拿着手电筒。

entries.en: She opened the Nagel catalogue and discovered that several pages were stuck together.
entries.zh: 她打开纳高的拍卖目录，发现有几页粘在了一起。

entries.en: McNulty opened the window and sent the loose receipts flying across the room.
entries.zh: 麦克纳尔蒂一开窗，散放的收据就飞得满屋都是。

entries.en: McKinlay moved the mirror until it no longer reflected the bare bulb.
entries.zh: 麦金利挪动镜子，直到镜中不再映出那个裸露的灯泡。

entries.en: Mauro had brought the chess pieces in a tin that smelled of biscuits.
entries.zh: 莫罗用一只带着饼干气味的铁罐装着棋子带了过来。

entries.en: Macduff promised to return the ladder before the painters arrived.
entries.zh: 麦克达夫答应在油漆工到来之前归还梯子。

entries.en: Holton found the missing shirt button inside the folded napkin.
entries.zh: 霍尔顿在折起来的餐巾里找到了丢失的衬衫纽扣。

entries.en: Ghandi traced the leak to a cracked joint behind the cupboard.
entries.zh: 甘迪查出，漏水处是橱柜后面一处裂开的接头。

entries.en: Fogg caught the last falling book but could not save the lamp.
entries.zh: 福格接住了最后一本掉下来的书，却没能保住灯。
